meta.coverage_caveat: entry snapshots are only logged while NO position is held; the counterfactual universe inside the final minutes is therefore conditioned on the policy not holding (60 of 112 closes had a position)
meta.execution_model: sol_v1.side_levels/walk depth-weighted for lot 10 (partial allowed, never beyond displayed) + 1 tick; Kalshi taker fee ceil-to-cent per order; absent side => no fill

selection_rule_IS: mean > 0, t >= 1.0, >= 10 closes (first half); mirrored for losers
